text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock D and Stock B at gains, which felt rewarding; I should not let that satisfaction alone decide when to sell.","My average cost is not a reason to keep a losing position or sell a winning one; I should judge each holding by its role and risk in the portfolio.","With prices unpredictable and my trading infrequent, I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and make deliberate, diversified decisions."]}
